vendors.name: The Westgate Hotel
vendors.tagline: French elegance across from the Civic Theatre
vendors.description: Independent luxury hotel with a Versailles-inspired Grand Lobby. Home to Afternoon Tea, Bonne Vie Brasserie & Bar with live jazz Thursday to Saturday, and Sunday brunch.
vendors.hours: Afternoon Tea Wed to Sun 12pm to 3pm; live music Thu to Sat 6:30pm to 9pm

vendors.name: Horton Grand Hotel
